sloka: आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्षो रश्मिभिर्भाति रावणः ।सुव्यक्तं लक्षये ह्यस्य रूपं तेजस्समावृतम् ।। ६.५९.२७ ।।।।
transliteration: āditya iva duṣprekṣo raśmibhirbhāti rāvaṇaḥ ।suvyaktaṁ lakṣaye hyasya rūpaṁ tejassamāvṛtam ।। 6.59.27 ।।।।

translations.english: "Ravana blazing like the sun is difficult to gaze even. His shine is spread all over and not perceptible to discern."
